title: Laredo to host candidate forums for District VIII race tonight and mayoral runoff Nov. 18
excerpt: Laredo voters get two chances to hear the candidates face to face before the December elections: a District VIII forum tonight, Nov. 12, and a mayoral forum Nov. 18, both at 6:30 p.m. in City Hall Council Chambers.
content:
The City of Laredo is hosting candidate forums for the two city races still on the ballot, giving voters a chance to hear from the candidates before the December elections, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The District VIII forum is tonight, Thursday, Nov. 12, and the mayoral forum is Tuesday, Nov. 18. Both forums begin at 6:30 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, the report said.

The mayoral runoff on Dec. 12 pits District VIII Councilwoman Alyssa Cigarroa against incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño. Cigarroa led the five-candidate field on Nov. 3 with 35.10% of the vote, followed by Treviño with 32.5%, according to KGNS.

The District VIII contest is a special election on Saturday, Dec. 5, to fill the council seat, according to a city resolution ordering the election. Early voting for that special election runs Nov. 23 through Dec. 1.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 11, 2026; KGNS, Nov. 4, 2026; City of Laredo Resolution No. 2026-R-205.
